# MindBody

## Physical Therapy for Mental Health

### Movement-based care for anxiety, depression, trauma, and more

Physical therapy isn’t just for injuries—it can support mental health, too. The American Physical Therapy Association now recognizes physical therapy as a tool to help manage mental health diagnoses like anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and eating disorders.

Our MindBody program at Doctors of Physical Therapy combines the latest research with hands-on care. Specialized therapists are trained to address how movement, posture, breath, and physical tension affect mental well-being. While not a replacement for counseling, physical therapy works alongside mental health care to reduce symptoms and improve quality of life. And yes, **it is covered by insurance just like “normal” physical therapy!**

## What MindBody Offers:

- Physical therapy for anxiety and depression
- Support for trauma recovery and emotional regulation
- Treatment of chronic pain linked to mental health
- Collaborative care with licensed mental health providers

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## Backed by science. Guided by compassion.

MindBody is an evolving program grounded in the latest evidence, ensuring patients receive safe, effective care tailored specifically to their needs. MindBody services are currently available **only at** **select Doctors of Physical Therapy locations**. Please call your **[local clinic](https://doctorsofphysicaltherapy.com/our-locations/)** today to find the nearest location offering MindBody and schedule your consultation.

## Ready To Get Moving Again? Get A Appointment Now!

No need to wait any longer to start feeling better! Get signed up now for an appointment now to get back to the life you love!

[Schedule Now](https://members.drsofpt.com/dpt/welcome)
